title: Confirm GA4 data retention and align the privacy page
description:
As the site owner, I want the privacy page retention statement to match the actual GA4 setting.

Steps: in GA4 Admin > Data collection and modification > Data retention, check the event data retention (2 or 14 months) and set it deliberately; then update the retention sentence on the /privacy/ page (Anth.us-web#77) to match.

Acceptance criteria:
Scenario: Setting confirmed
  Given Ryan opens the GA4 data retention settings
  Then the chosen event data retention period is recorded in this issue
Scenario: Page matches
  Given the privacy page is published
  Then its retention sentence states the same period as GA4

Dependencies: Anth.us-web#77 (content); should be settled before the consent banner ships.
